title: Jaipur — Pink City
text: Jaipur is best for forts, palace architecture, bazaars, craft shopping and food. Group Amber Fort, Panna Meena ka Kund and Jaigarh in one northern day; group City Palace, Hawa Mahal, Jantar Mantar and Johari Bazaar in the old city. Start outdoor sites early in warm months.

title: Udaipur — City of Lakes
text: Udaipur suits lakefront heritage, relaxed evenings and romantic trips. City Palace, Jagdish Temple and Lake Pichola are walkable as an old-city cluster. Fateh Sagar and Sajjangarh suit a separate sunset outing. Lake boat operations and timings must be checked locally.

title: Jodhpur — Blue City
text: Jodhpur combines Mehrangarh Fort, Jaswant Thada, Toorji Ka Jhalra and blue-city lanes. Pair Mehrangarh and Jaswant Thada, then explore Clock Tower and Sardar Market later. Heat and uneven heritage lanes can affect accessibility.

title: Jaisalmer — Desert Gateway
text: Jaisalmer works best with one fort-and-havelis day and one desert day. Sam is busier and more tourism-oriented; Khuri is often a quieter alternative. Confirm camp conditions, inclusions, operator credentials and transport before booking; desert activities need sun protection and water.

title: Pushkar and Ajmer transport and destination guide
text: Pushkar offers ghats, Brahma Temple, Savitri viewpoint and markets; Ajmer adds Ajmer Sharif and heritage stops. For transport, Rajasthan Tourism says Pushkar is connected by regular buses to Jaipur, Jodhpur and Ajmer. Pushkar Terminus is connected to Ajmer railway station, about 14 kilometres away. Sanganer Airport in Jaipur is listed as the nearest airport at 146 kilometres. Verify current bus stops, operators, schedules, fares and onward transfers before travel. At religious sites, dress modestly, remove footwear where required and ask before photographing people or ceremonies.

title: Ranthambore
text: Ranthambore visits need buffer time for safari reporting and travel. Wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed. Safari zones, permits, availability, fees and reporting times are time-sensitive and must be verified with official booking channels.

title: Mount Abu
text: Mount Abu is Rajasthan's hill-station option, useful for cooler weather, Dilwara temples, viewpoints and Nakki Lake. Temple etiquette and any photography rules should be respected.

title: Bundi
